description: 한국수력원자력(주)_한수원 전원 별 송전량 정보 [nuclear facilities] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 한국수력원자력(주). “한수원 전원별 송전량 정보” API는 한국수력원자력㈜이 제공하는 공공데이터 서비스입니다. 이 API는 한국수력원자력에서 운영 중인 원자력발전소(고리원자력본부, 한빛원자력본부, 월성원자력본부, 한울원자력본부, 새울원자력본부)의 일일 송전량 정보를 XML 형식으로 제공합니다. 이 API 서비스를 활용하여... Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 한국수력원자력(주). Its tags are 전력거래, 송전량, 발전소, 원자력발전소, 발전기별 일일 송전량. It offers 1 resource(s) in xml. The portal shows 2026-03-23 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy supply studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
